pending_approvals.script: Day 42 with three house rabbits, and Pip just proved playpen fences are purely decorative. Barnaby didn't even blink. Which of your pets is the chaos gremlin?
Maya’s budget cuts hit hard, yet Barnaby and Pip stay curious, while baby kits Clover and Pip grow fast. Tough times test love, money, and bunny hops in our busy daily lives.
As a pet lover Maya's 26 UK pet owner watches adolescent Barnaby and baby kits Pip Clover struggle tough economy pinch every single day. Do your bunnies feel the squeeze too?
